name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, 2025 edition
note: The ids and titles are OWASP's. The descriptions are Redflag's own plain-language summaries.

risks.name: Prompt Injection
risks.description: Text from a user, or hidden in a document the bot reads, changes what the bot does in ways its builders did not intend.

risks.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
risks.description: The bot reveals private or confidential data, such as another customer's details or a secret it was given.

risks.name: Supply Chain
risks.description: Outside models, data or components the app depends on bring in weaknesses.

risks.name: Data and Model Poisoning
risks.description: Tampered training, fine-tuning or embedding data corrupts the model's behavior.

risks.name: Improper Output Handling
risks.description: The bot's output is passed on without checking, so it can attack whatever displays or uses it.

risks.name: Excessive Agency
risks.description: The bot is given too much power and takes actions, such as refunds or emails, that it should not.

risks.name: System Prompt Leakage
risks.description: The bot's hidden instructions are exposed to users.

risks.name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
risks.description: Flaws in how search data is stored or retrieved create security risks in apps that look things up.

risks.name: Misinformation
risks.description: False or misleading output harms people or systems that rely on it.

risks.name: Unbounded Consumption
risks.description: Uncontrolled use of the model leads to runaway cost or service disruption.
